subject: vocab
title: 準1級 頻出形容詞・副詞 40
summary:
- 形容词 35 个 + 副词 5 个
- 形近陷阱：**eligible**（有资格的）vs illegible（难以辨认的）、**negligible**（微不足道）vs negligent（疏忽的）、**comprehensive**（全面的）vs comprehensible（可理解的）
- 意思容易搞错：**indifferent**＝不关心（不是“没区别”）、**virtually**＝几乎（不是“虚拟地”）、**notorious**＝臭名昭著（只用于坏事）
- 写作评分也看这些：**coherent**（连贯）、explicit、crucial、substantial

cards.ex: Many elderly people do not have adequate income to live on.
cards.exTr: 许多老年人没有足够的收入维持生活。
cards.cloze: Many elderly people do not have ＿＿＿ income to live on.

cards.ex: The new shopping mall is located in an affluent neighborhood.
cards.exTr: 新购物中心位于一个富人区。
cards.cloze: The new shopping mall is located in an ＿＿＿ neighborhood.

cards.ex: It soon became apparent that the plan would not work.
cards.exTr: 很快就看出这个计划行不通。
cards.cloze: It soon became ＿＿＿ that the plan would not work.

cards.ja: はっきり話せる；明瞭な
cards.ex: She is an articulate speaker who can explain complex ideas clearly.
cards.exTr: 她口才很好，能把复杂的想法讲得很清楚。
cards.cloze: She is an ＿＿＿ speaker who can explain complex ideas clearly.
cards.note: 也可作动词：清楚地表达

cards.ex: The restaurant is famous for its authentic Italian food.
cards.exTr: 这家餐厅以正宗的意大利菜而闻名。
cards.cloze: The restaurant is famous for its ＿＿＿ Italian food.

cards.ex: The benevolent businessman donated millions of dollars to local schools.
cards.exTr: 那位乐善好施的商人向当地学校捐了数百万美元。
cards.cloze: The ＿＿＿ businessman donated millions of dollars to local schools.

cards.ex: Thank you for your candid opinion; it helped me see the problem clearly.
cards.exTr: 谢谢你坦率的意见，它让我看清了问题。
cards.cloze: Thank you for your ＿＿＿ opinion; it helped me see the problem clearly.

cards.ja: 首尾一貫した；筋の通った
cards.ex: The essay was well organized and presented a coherent argument.
cards.exTr: 这篇文章结构清晰，论证连贯。
cards.cloze: The essay was well organized and presented a ＿＿＿ argument.
cards.note: 反义：incoherent；写作的“構成”就看这个

cards.ex: After winning three games in a row, the team became complacent and lost the next one.
cards.exTr: 连赢三场后，球队自满起来，结果输了下一场。
cards.cloze: After winning three games in a row, the team became ＿＿＿ and lost the next one.

cards.ex: The report provides a comprehensive review of the country's education system.
cards.exTr: 这份报告对该国的教育制度做了全面的评述。
cards.cloze: The report provides a ＿＿＿ review of the country's education system.

cards.ja: 決定的な；極めて重要な
cards.ex: Getting enough sleep is crucial for students' health and performance.
cards.exTr: 充足的睡眠对学生的健康和成绩至关重要。
cards.cloze: Getting enough sleep is ＿＿＿ for students' health and performance.

cards.ex: The police believe the fire was a deliberate act, not an accident.
cards.exTr: 警方认为这场火是有人故意放的，不是意外。
cards.cloze: The police believe the fire was a ＿＿＿ act, not an accident.

cards.ex: Too much screen time can be detrimental to children's eyesight.
cards.exTr: 看屏幕时间太长会损害孩子的视力。
cards.cloze: Too much screen time can be ＿＿＿ to children's eyesight.

cards.ex: He is a diligent student who always finishes his homework on time.
cards.exTr: 他是个勤奋的学生，总是按时完成作业。
cards.cloze: He is a ＿＿＿ student who always finishes his homework on time.

cards.ex: Students with high grades are eligible for a scholarship.
cards.exTr: 成绩好的学生有资格申请奖学金。
cards.cloze: Students with high grades are ＿＿＿ for a scholarship.
cards.colloc: be eligible for ～ / be eligible to do

cards.ex: The teacher gave explicit instructions about how to write the report.
cards.exTr: 老师对怎么写报告给出了明确的指示。
cards.cloze: The teacher gave ＿＿＿ instructions about how to write the report.

cards.ex: The local people were hostile to the plan to build a garbage plant nearby.
cards.exTr: 当地人强烈反对在附近建垃圾处理厂的计划。
cards.cloze: The local people were ＿＿＿ to the plan to build a garbage plant nearby.

cards.ex: The project required an immense amount of time and money.
cards.exTr: 这个项目需要大量的时间和金钱。
cards.cloze: The project required an ＿＿＿ amount of time and money.

cards.ex: A judge must remain impartial and listen to both sides.
cards.exTr: 法官必须保持公正，听取双方的意见。
cards.cloze: A judge must remain ＿＿＿ and listen to both sides.

cards.ex: Many young people are indifferent to politics and do not vote.
cards.exTr: 很多年轻人对政治漠不关心，不去投票。
cards.cloze: Many young people are ＿＿＿ to politics and do not vote.

cards.ex: The watch contains hundreds of intricate parts.
cards.exTr: 这块手表里有几百个精密复杂的零件。
cards.cloze: The watch contains hundreds of ＿＿＿ parts.

cards.ex: They held a lavish wedding party at an expensive hotel.
cards.exTr: 他们在一家昂贵的酒店举办了奢华的婚宴。
cards.cloze: They held a ＿＿＿ wedding party at an expensive hotel.

cards.ex: Wearing a helmet is mandatory for all workers at the construction site.
cards.exTr: 工地上所有工人都必须戴安全帽。
cards.cloze: Wearing a helmet is ＿＿＿ for all workers at the construction site.

cards.ex: Despite her great success, she remained modest about her achievements.
cards.exTr: 尽管非常成功，她对自己的成就依然很谦虚。
cards.cloze: Despite her great success, she remained ＿＿＿ about her achievements.

cards.ja: 無視できるほどの；ごくわずかな
cards.ex: The difference in price between the two products is negligible.
cards.exTr: 这两种产品的价格差别微乎其微。
cards.cloze: The difference in price between the two products is ＿＿＿.

cards.ex: The area was once notorious for its high crime rate.
cards.exTr: 这一带曾经因犯罪率高而臭名昭著。
cards.cloze: The area was once ＿＿＿ for its high crime rate.
cards.note: 和 famous 不同，只用于坏事

cards.ex: The meaning of the old poem is obscure, even to experts.
cards.exTr: 这首古诗的意思连专家都不太清楚。
cards.cloze: The meaning of the old poem is ＿＿＿, even to experts.

cards.ex: Despite the bad economy, the company is optimistic about next year's sales.
cards.exTr: 尽管经济不景气，公司对明年的销售仍然乐观。
cards.cloze: Despite the bad economy, the company is ＿＿＿ about next year's sales.

cards.ex: He went to see a doctor about his persistent cough.
cards.exTr: 他因为一直咳嗽不止去看了医生。
cards.cloze: He went to see a doctor about his ＿＿＿ cough.

cards.ex: We need a pragmatic solution that can be put into practice quickly.
cards.exTr: 我们需要一个能尽快付诸实施的务实方案。
cards.cloze: We need a ＿＿＿ solution that can be put into practice quickly.

cards.ex: Reckless driving is one of the main causes of traffic accidents.
cards.exTr: 鲁莽驾驶是交通事故的主要原因之一。
cards.cloze: ＿＿＿ driving is one of the main causes of traffic accidents.

cards.ex: Please remove any redundant words from your essay to make it clearer.
cards.exTr: 请删掉作文里多余的词，让它更清楚。
cards.cloze: Please remove any ＿＿＿ words from your essay to make it clearer.
cards.note: 英式英语里 be made redundant＝被裁员

cards.ex: The country's economy has remained robust despite the global slowdown.
cards.exTr: 尽管全球经济放缓，该国经济依然稳健。
cards.cloze: The country's economy has remained ＿＿＿ despite the global slowdown.

cards.ja: 自発的な；自然発生的な
cards.ex: The audience broke into spontaneous applause at the end of the speech.
cards.exTr: 演讲结束时，观众自发地鼓起掌来。
cards.cloze: The audience broke into ＿＿＿ applause at the end of the speech.

cards.ex: The company made a substantial profit last year.
cards.exTr: 这家公司去年赚了一大笔利润。
cards.cloze: The company made a ＿＿＿ profit last year.

cards.ex: If you don't get enough sleep, your work will inevitably suffer.
cards.exTr: 睡眠不足的话，工作必然会受影响。
cards.cloze: If you don't get enough sleep, your work will ＿＿＿ suffer.

cards.ex: The town's population is predominantly elderly.
cards.exTr: 这个镇的人口以老年人为主。
cards.cloze: The town's population is ＿＿＿ elderly.

cards.ex: He reluctantly agreed to work on Sunday because his boss asked him to.
cards.exTr: 因为老板要求，他勉强同意周日上班。
cards.cloze: He ＿＿＿ agreed to work on Sunday because his boss asked him to.

cards.ex: Smartphones are now used by virtually everyone in the country.
cards.exTr: 如今这个国家几乎人人都在用智能手机。
cards.cloze: Smartphones are now used by ＿＿＿ everyone in the country.

cards.ex: It was so dark that I could scarcely see the road.
cards.exTr: 天太黑了，我几乎看不清路。
cards.cloze: It was so dark that I could ＿＿＿ see the road.
cards.note: 否定意义的副词，和 hardly 一样
